backend/main.mo: Main backend actor defining Product, Order, and Cart types with CRUD operations for products, cart management (add/remove/get), order placement, admin authentication, and price updates using stable storage with Map and List data structures.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three high-confidence features related to debugging getAllProducts query failures, adding comprehensive error logging for data flow tracking, and ensuring proper actor initialization with error handling.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of frontend files including React components, hooks, pages, and utilities, highlighting extensive console logging, error handling, React Query integration, and Indian grocery store theming throughout the application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining OKLCH color system variables for light and dark modes with neutral grayscale palette for background, foreground, borders, and UI components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Swapan Store application with root div and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component configuring TanStack Router with routes for products (root), cart, checkout, admin dashboard, and admin login, wrapping routes with ErrorBoundary and applying Header/Footer layout conditionally.
Dialog modal component for creating new products with form inputs for name, description, price, category, and image URL, including validation and integration with useCreateProduct mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/EditProductModal: Dialog modal component for editing existing products, pre-populating form fields from product prop and submitting updates via useUpdateProduct mutation hook with validation.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary component that catches and displays errors with detailed stack traces, component stacks, and provides reset/reload options.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright information and a "Built with caffeine.ai" attribution link with UTM tracking parameters.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header component with logo, search bar, navigation links (Products/Admin), and cart button with item count badge.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Product card component displaying product image, name, description, price, category badge, and quantity selector with add-to-cart functionality. Includes extensive logging and defensive null checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages an ICP actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: Simple admin authentication hook using sessionStorage to persist login state with login/logout functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing AuthClient creation, login flow, identity state, and delegation validity.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching products, managing cart operations (add/remove/get contents), and handling orders with extensive logging and error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, earthy Indian spice market color palette for both light and dark modes, including primary (turmeric yellow), secondary, accent, and destructive colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching, InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, and renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page displaying products and orders tables with functionality to add/edit products, update prices, and manage orders; includes authentication check and loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Admin login page with password verification form that authenticates users and redirects to admin dashboard on successful login.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Shopping cart page displaying cart items with quantity, prices, and remove functionality; calculates subtotal/total and provides checkout navigation with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page with form for phone number and address input, displays order summary from cart, and handles order placement with validation and success/error notifications.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Main products listing page with category filtering, search functionality, and product grid display; maps backend product images to local generated assets and includes extensive debug logging.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrice.ts: Utility function that formats numeric price values to Indian Rupee format with ₹ symbol prefix and two decimal places.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, Inter/Poppins fonts, custom shadows, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting an e-commerce application with a critical issue where products fail to display on the product page, with three existing features addressing frontend query debugging, error logging, and actor initialization, plus one pending backend verification request.
